entities.name: St. Mary's Monastery, Zvërnec
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Mary’s Monastery is an Orthodox monastery located on the Zvërnec Island, in the Narta Lagoon near the village of Zvërnec within the municipality of Vlora. It houses a church dedicated to the Dormition of Mary Theotókos.
